title: Clear the short jobs
hook: Same total work, different waiting time for the people in this queue.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Compare total waiting under two orders.

objective: Compare total waiting under two orders.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Same total work, different waiting time for the people in this queue. With all jobs ready, which reduces total waiting in this fixture? Correct option: Short jobs first. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: Total waiting is the sum of each start time. Moving a short job ahead reduces how long later jobs wait; this objective ignores deadlines.

recall.question: Three people wait at one desk with jobs of 2, 8 and 20 minutes, all ready now. Which order gives the least total waiting?
recall.why: Total waiting is the sum of start times: 0 + 2 + 10 = 12 for 2, 8, 20, against 0 + 20 + 28 = 48 for 20, 8, 2.
